pattern_id: Transient-Invalid Persistence Poisoning via Finality/Safety Anchors
description: A transient inability to execute (missing state) is treated as proof of invalidity. Persisting this classification creates a self-sustaining poison pill: subsequent forkchoice updates consult invalid/bad-block caches and reject canonical anchors. This breaks replica convergence because other nodes (with intact state) accept the chain as valid, while the poisoned node permanently refuses it.
fault_type: crash_recovery + byzantine_or_buggy_coordinator (Engine API caller) + storage_fault (missing state)
trigger_condition: - A node validates a proposed block while missing required execution state (parent state/trie nodes), causing execution to fail.
